description: The cube is almost solved. The U face is entirely yellow, and the D face is entirely white. The bottom two layers are solved. However, the top row of each side face is misaligned: the front face (red center) has blue stickers across its top row, the right face (green center) has red stickers across its top row, the back face (orange center) has green stickers across its top row, and the left face (blue center) has orange stickers across its top row. Solve the cube.
notes: One-move solve: U. Tests basic top-layer spatial reasoning.
